topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Group code of conduct and annual security acknowledgments; sanctions procedure (POL-01 4.7)
Board risk committee oversees cyber risk each quarter; board audit committee oversees internal audit
Group CISO, division security and compliance leads, and service line owners with defined reporting lines (POL-01)
Role-based hiring requirements, training, and annual reviews for engineering and operations staff
Control owners named in the common control catalog and the service line control matrix; performance goals include security duties
Asset inventory, data flow diagrams, and logs for the service feed control operation

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies, supplements, and security responsibilities communicated at hire and every year
System description and communication of commitments to clients
control_owner: Grid Engineering security and compliance lead
gap: The description presents group identity, SOC, and cloud controls as division controls; the auditor could not trace 9 controls to evidence (P03 ES-G21)
remediation: Inheritance matrix and revised description that names the group services (POAM-014)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Service objectives and commitments drive the division risk register
SP 800-30 risk analysis each year with roll-up to group (POL-01 4.3)
Fraud risk considered in the group ERM and internal audit plans
Significant changes assessed for risk before release
Annual common control assessment and division samples by group internal audit (P07)
Findings tracked in the POA&M and reported to the board risk committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53 High baseline and the common control catalog
Technology general controls: identity, change, operations, and backup provided as group common controls

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Division standards consistent with group policy
control_owner: Grid Engineering security and compliance lead
gap: 2023 standards conflict with group policy on retention, media, passwords, and severity (P07 PL-1)
remediation: Replace with the Grid Engineering supplement (POAM-014)

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Group identity platform (SYS-G1) with SSO and MFA; tenant isolation in the application
Joiner-mover-leaver process from the HR system; access removed within 4 hours of termination
Role-based folder access with client-authorized membership for BCSI and CEII
gap: Project-wide groups reach BCSI and CEII folders on 2 of 20 sampled projects (P07 AC-3)

control_description: Physical security of data centers inherited from cloud provider B (carved out)
Media sanitization in provider data centers (carved out); laptops wiped with certificates

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Landing-zone network controls and web application firewall; deny by default

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: Restriction of data movement off the platform
gap: External links blocked only for CEII-tagged folders; personal cloud storage not blocked on engineering laptops
remediation: Block personal cloud storage; extend link blocking to BCSI folders (POAM-013)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on servers and endpoints; allowlisting on build agents

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Vulnerability scanning and configuration monitoring of cloud workloads (P07 RA-5, CM-6)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: Monitoring for anomalies with logs kept as committed
gap: Platform audit logs kept 90 days against a 12-month commitment; deviation noted in the 2026 report (P07 AU-11)
remediation: Send logs to the group archive with 1-year retention (POAM-022)

control_description: SOC triage and severity rules (POL-03)
Incident response including client notices
gap: No client terms register or SOC-to-contracts handoff (P03 ES-G07)
remediation: Client terms register and handoff; exercise in the 2026-12 tabletop (POAM-012)

control_description: Recovery runbooks and immutable backups in provider B
Change authorization, testing, and approval in the deployment pipeline
Business continuity plans and cyber insurance

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Monitoring of group services and provider B as service providers to the platform
control_owner: Grid Engineering security and compliance lead
gap: Provider B is reviewed; the group services the platform relies on are not monitored as providers because inheritance is undocumented
remediation: Annual confirmation of inherited controls from the P07 common control results (POAM-014)
